theory_basis.interpretation: Gamma-dot contributes locally to rate lift and the shed-vorticity flow-tangency correction. Group columns only when both nodal load and tested flow supports are disjoint. Fourier sample/test matrices retain their full supports. This changes how the existing exact symmetric load coefficients are assembled, not the physical equations or nonlinear quadratic drag. Feedback keeps individual probes because sensor/controller combinations can be nonlocal.
theory_basis.scope: A scoped implementation optimization; no claim of complete ASWING discrete/executable parity.
